scanNote:
WORKBOOK 2-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (8-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 2', yonida katta qora 'Night and Day'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Look at the key below and complete the times, as in the examples.' QUTI: 'am = ante meridiem (before 12 noon); pm = post meridiem (after 12 noon)'. 1 8 am = eight ...o'clock in the morning... 2 6 pm = six ...o'clock in the evening... 3 4 am = four ........ 4 5:30 am = half ........ 5 10:15 pm = a quarter ........ 6 9:45 am = a quarter ........ 7 3:20 pm = twenty ........
2) 'Fill in the gaps in the chart below.' (o'rtada to'q sariq 'OR') 1 6:20 ........ / twenty past six; 2 4:30 four thirty / ........; 3 9:15 nine fifteen / ........; 4 10:50 ........ / ten to eleven; 5 1:45 one forty-five / ........
3) 'Look at John's daily routine, then make short dialogues, as in the example.' 9 RASM: 1 budilnik 7:00/wake up; 2 dush 7:15/have a shower; 3 nonushta (sut, quruq nonushta) 7:30/have breakfast; 4 avtobus 8:00/catch the bus; 5 stolda telefonda gaplashayotgan erkak 9:00/start work; 6 soat 5:00/leave work; 7 spagetti 6:30/have dinner; 8 televizorda yangiliklar ('FOREST FIRE') 9:30/watch the news; 9 karavot 10:30/go to bed.

O'NG USTUN (3-mashq davomi): 1 A: ...What time does John wake up?... B: ...He wakes up at seven o'clock in the morning.... 2-9 A:/B: bo'sh qatorlar.
4) 'Fill in the table with play, have, do and go, then use the phrases to make sentences about yourself or your family, as in the example.' 4 KATAK: [......] my homework, the shopping, the ironing | [......] football, computer games, the piano | [......] to school, to work, to the cinema | [......] lunch, tea, a shower. Qiya namuna: 'I do my homework in the evening. Mum does the shopping on Saturday mornings.'
• 'Grammar':
5) 'Look at the chart below and make sentences, as in the example.' JADVAL: NAME / SUBJECT / START / FINISH: Ken - History - 10:45 - 12:00; Nancy - Maths - 9:00 - 9:50; Kelly - Music - 1:30 - 2:10. Ken surati (yosh yigit). Qiya namuna: 'Ken is a student. His History lesson starts at a quarter to eleven. It finishes at twelve o'clock.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '8'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the key below and complete the times, as in the examples. am = ante meridiem (before 12 noon); pm = post meridiem (after 12 noon).
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi kalitga qarang va vaqtlarni to'ldiring, namunalardagidek. am = ante meridiem (tushgacha, 12 dan oldin); pm = post meridiem (tushdan keyin, 12 dan keyin).
exercises.explanationUz:
AM / PM - 12 SOATLIK TIZIM.

  am = ante meridiem (lotincha:
    tushdan OLDIN) = 00:00-11:59
  pm = post meridiem (lotincha:
    tushdan KEYIN) = 12:00-23:59

  ⚠ 'noon' = tush (12:00 kunduzi)
  ⚠ 'midnight' = yarim tun (12:00
  tunda)


⚠ SO'Z BILAN AYTGANDA am/pm
  O'RNIGA:

  in the morning   = 5-12 (am)
  in the afternoon = 12-17 (pm)
  in the evening   = 17-21 (pm)
  at night         = 21-5


⚠ VAQT AYTISh QOIDASI:

  8:00 = eight o'clock
  5:30 = half PAST five
  10:15 = a quarter PAST ten
  9:45 = a quarter TO ten
  3:20 = twenty PAST three

  ⚠ 'past' = ... dan o'tdi (:01-:30)
  ⚠ 'to' = ... ga qoldi (:31-:59)
  ⚠ 'o'clock' - FAQAT to'liq soatda.


⚠ 4 AM = 'four o'clock in the
  morning' - ha, tong 4 ham
  'morning'!

items.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA. To'liq soat → 'o'clock'; am → 'in the morning'.
⚠ To'liq soat → 'o'clock'. 4 am - tong → 'in the morning'.

⚠ :30 = 'half PAST' + soat. am → 'in the morning'.
⚠ 'o'clock' YO'Q - to'liq soat emas.

⚠ :15 = 'a quarter PAST'. 10 pm = tun → 'at night'.
⚠ 'in the evening' ham qabul qilinadi.

⚠ :45 = 'a quarter TO' + KEYINGI soat (ten).
⚠ 'to nine' - XATO!

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps in the chart below. (two ways of saying the time)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvaldagi bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring. (vaqtni aytishning ikki usuli)
exercises.explanationUz:
VAQTNI AYTIShNING IKKI USULI:

  1) RAQAMLAB (digital):
     6:20 = six twenty
     4:30 = four thirty
     ⚠ Oddiy - soat + daqiqa.

  2) AN'ANAVIY (past/to):
     6:20 = twenty past six
     4:30 = half past four
     ⚠ Daqiqa OLDIN, soat KEYIN.


⚠ 'TO' BILAN - KEYINGI SOAT:

  10:50 = ten TO eleven
  1:45 = a quarter TO two


⚠ 'A QUARTER' = 15 DAQIQA:

  9:15 = a quarter past nine
  ⚠ 'quarter' oldidan 'A' (Brit.).

exercises.instructionEn: Look at John's daily routine, then make short dialogues, as in the example. 1 7:00/wake up 2 7:15/have a shower 3 7:30/have breakfast 4 8:00/catch the bus 5 9:00/start work 6 5:00/leave work 7 6:30/have dinner 8 9:30/watch the news 9 10:30/go to bed
exercises.instructionUz: Johnning kundalik tartibiga qarang, so'ng qisqa dialoglar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 7:00/wake up 2 7:15/have a shower 3 7:30/have breakfast 4 8:00/catch the bus 5 9:00/start work 6 5:00/leave work 7 6:30/have dinner 8 9:30/watch the news 9 10:30/go to bed
exercises.explanationUz:
KUNDALIK TARTIB - SAVOL-JAVOB.
  (coursebook 14-bet 11-mashq
  Johnni eslang)

QOLIP:
  A: What time does John + FE'L?
  B: He + FE'L-S + at + VAQT + in
     the morning/afternoon/evening/
     at night.

  ⚠ Savolda 'does' + oddiy fe'l
  ⚠ Javobda fe'l + S (wakes, has,
  catches, goes)


⚠ VAQTLAR:

  7:00  seven o'clock (morning)
  7:15  a quarter past seven
  7:30  half past seven
  8:00  eight o'clock
  9:00  nine o'clock
  5:00  five o'clock (afternoon)
  6:30  half past six (evening)
  9:30  half past nine (evening/
        night)
  10:30 half past ten (night)


⚠ 'TO CATCH THE BUS':

  = avtobusga ulgurmoq/chiqmoq.
  ⚠ 'catch' → 'catches' (-es).


⚠ 'TO WATCH THE NEWS':

  'the news' = yangiliklar (BIRLIK!).
  ⚠ 'watch' → 'watches'.


⚠ 'TO WAKE UP' vs 'GET UP':

  wake up = uyg'onmoq
  get up = o'rnidan turmoq.

items.question: What time does John wake up?
items.answer: He wakes up at seven o'clock in the morning.

items.prompt: U soat nechada dush qabul qiladi?
items.question: What time does John have a shower?
items.answer: He has a shower at a quarter past seven in the morning.

items.question: What time does John have breakfast?
items.answer: He has breakfast at half past seven in the morning.

items.question: What time does John catch the bus?
items.answer: He catches the bus at eight o'clock in the morning.

items.question: What time does John start work?
items.answer: He starts work at nine o'clock in the morning.

items.question: What time does John leave work?
items.answer: He leaves work at five o'clock in the afternoon.

items.prompt: U soat nechada kechki ovqat qiladi?
items.question: What time does John have dinner?
items.answer: He has dinner at half past six in the evening.

items.question: What time does John watch the news?
items.answer: He watches the news at half past nine in the evening.

items.question: What time does John go to bed?
items.answer: He goes to bed at half past ten at night.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 10:30 = 'half past ten AT NIGHT'. 'go' → 'goES'. 'go to bed' - artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the table with play, have, do and go, then use the phrases to make sentences about yourself or your family, as in the example. [___] my homework, the shopping, the ironing | [___] football, computer games, the piano | [___] to school, to work, to the cinema | [___] lunch, tea, a shower. Example: I do my homework in the evening. Mum does the shopping on Saturday mornings.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni play, have, do va go bilan to'ldiring, so'ng iboralar bilan o'zingiz yoki oilangiz haqida gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. [___] my homework, the shopping, the ironing | [___] football, computer games, the piano | [___] to school, to work, to the cinema | [___] lunch, tea, a shower. Namuna: Men uy vazifamni kechqurun bajaraman. Oyim shanba kunlari ertalab xarid qiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
DO / PLAY / GO / HAVE - TURG'UN
  BIRIKMALAR (coursebook 12-bet
  1-mashq bilan bir xil).

  DO + ish/vazifa:
    do my homework, do the shopping,
    do the ironing
    ⚠ 'make' EMAS!

  PLAY + o'yin/sport/cholg'u:
    play football, play computer
    games, play THE piano
    ⚠ Cholg'u oldidan 'THE', sport
    oldidan artikl YO'Q.

  GO + TO + joy:
    go to school, go to work, go to
    the cinema
    ⚠ 'go to school/work' - artiklsiz;
    'go to THE cinema' - artikl bilan.

  HAVE + ovqat/dush:
    have lunch, have tea, have a
    shower
    ⚠ 'have' = yemoq/ichmoq/qabul
    qilmoq.


⚠ 'THE IRONING':

  = dazmol qilish. 'to iron' =
  dazmollamoq.


⚠ 'HAVE TEA':

  Brit. = choy ichmoq / kechki
  yengil ovqat.


⚠ 3-ShAXS: does, plays, goes, has.

items.textEn: ___ my homework / the shopping / the ironing
items.whyUz: ⚠ DO + ish: 'do my homework', 'do the shopping', 'do the ironing'.

items.textEn: ___ to school / to work / to the cinema

exercises.instructionEn: Use the phrases to make sentences about yourself or your family, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Iboralar bilan o'zingiz yoki oilangiz haqida gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP:
  I + FE'L + ibora + VAQT.
  Mum/Dad + FE'L-S + ibora + VAQT.

  ⚠ 'on Saturday mornings' -
  ko'plik = har shanba ertalab.
  ⚠ 'in the evening', 'after
  school', 'every day'.
exercises.exampleEn: I do my homework in the evening. Mum does the shopping on Saturday mornings.
exercises.exampleUz: Men uy vazifamni kechqurun bajaraman. Oyim shanba kunlari ertalab xarid qiladi.
modelAnswers: Mum does the ironing on Sunday afternoons.
I play football with my friends after school.
My brother plays computer games every evening.
My sister plays the piano on Saturdays.
I go to school at eight o'clock.
Dad goes to work by bus.
We go to the cinema on Friday evenings.
I have lunch at half past twelve.
We have tea at five o'clock.
I have a shower every morning.
modelAnswersUz: Oyim yakshanba kunlari tushdan keyin dazmol qiladi.
Men maktabdan keyin do'stlarim bilan futbol o'ynayman.
Akam har kuni kechqurun kompyuter o'yinlari o'ynaydi.
Biz juma kunlari kechqurun kinoga boramiz.
Men tushlikni o'n ikki yarimda qilaman.
Men har kuni ertalab dush qabul qilaman.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the chart below and make sentences, as in the example. NAME / SUBJECT / START / FINISH: Ken - History - 10:45 - 12:00; Nancy - Maths - 9:00 - 9:50; Kelly - Music - 1:30 - 2:10.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvalga qarang va gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. ISM / FAN / BOShLANISh / TUGASh: Ken - Tarix - 10:45 - 12:00; Nancy - Matematika - 9:00 - 9:50; Kelly - Musiqa - 1:30 - 2:10.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - JADVAL
  (dars vaqtlari).

  ⚠ Jadval, dastur, poyezd vaqti -
  har doim PRESENT SIMPLE:
  'The lesson STARTS at ...'
  'It FINISHES at ...'


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Ken is a student. His History
   lesson starts at a quarter to
   eleven. It finishes at twelve
   o'clock.'


⚠ VAQTLAR:

  10:45 = a quarter to eleven
  12:00 = twelve o'clock
  9:00  = nine o'clock
  9:50  = ten to ten
  1:30  = half past one
  2:10  = ten past two


⚠ 'HIS/HER + FAN + LESSON':

  Ken → HIS History lesson
  Nancy → HER Maths lesson
  ⚠ Fan nomi KATTA harf bilan.


⚠ 'FINISH' → 'FINISHES':

  -sh dan keyin -ES.


⚠ 'MATHS':

  Brit. 'Maths' / AQSh 'Math'.
exercises.exampleEn: Ken is a student. His History lesson starts at a quarter to eleven. It finishes at twelve o'clock.
exercises.exampleUz: Ken talaba. Uning Tarix darsi o'n birga chorak qolganda boshlanadi. U soat o'n ikkida tugaydi.
modelAnswers: Nancy is a student. Her Maths lesson starts at nine o'clock. It finishes at ten to ten.
Kelly is a student. Her Music lesson starts at half past one. It finishes at ten past two.
modelAnswersUz: Nensi talaba. Uning Matematika darsi soat to'qqizda boshlanadi. U o'nga o'n daqiqa qolganda tugaydi.
Kelli talaba. Uning Musiqa darsi bir yarimda boshlanadi. U ikkidan o'n daqiqa o'tganda tugaydi.

patterns.formula: What time does X + FE'L? - He/She + FE'L-s at + VAQT.
patterns.exampleEn: What time does John wake up? - He wakes up at seven o'clock in the morning.
patterns.exampleUz: John soat nechada uyg'onadi? - U ertalab soat yettida uyg'onadi.

patterns.formula: His/Her [fan] lesson starts at ... and finishes at ...
patterns.exampleEn: Her Maths lesson starts at nine o'clock and finishes at ten to ten.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning Matematika darsi soat to'qqizda boshlanib, o'nga o'n daqiqa qolganda tugaydi.
